# Rahul Gupta

> Personal website of Rahul Gupta — a Class 12 student and creator from Bihar, India. Includes study tools, Class 10 results lookup, referral offers, portfolio projects, and personal POVs (opinions and discussions).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, introductions, and highlights.
- [About](/about): About Rahul Gupta, background, interests, and mission.
- [Contact](/contact): Email, WhatsApp, and message form.
- [Portfolio](/portfolio): Websites, apps, and tools built by Rahul.
- [Portfolio — Websites](/portfolio/websites): Web projects.
- [Portfolio — Apps](/portfolio/apps): Mobile and cross-platform apps.
- [Portfolio — Tools](/portfolio/tools): Standalone utilities.
- [Referral Links](/referrals): Curated referral offers (UPI, shopping, food).
- [Referrals — UPI](/referrals/upi): UPI app referrals.
- [Referrals — Shopping](/referrals/shopping): Shopping app referrals.
- [Referrals — Food](/referrals/food): Food app referrals.
- [POVs](/pov): Discussion platform — quick takes, deep POVs, and Q&A.
- [POV — Philosophy](/pov/philosophy): Philosophical reflections.
- [POV — Society](/pov/society): Society-focused posts.
- [POV — Politics](/pov/politics): Political commentary.
- [POV — Personal](/pov/personal): Personal POVs.
- [Fund Rahul](/fund-rahul): Support Rahul's work.
- [Site Map](/site-map): All public pages and sections.
